producer_report.summary: `athena retry <job>` and `ask "try again on <job>"` now accept a stale job. A new `Athena::stale_seed` reads the stale job's recorded candidate and merges it onto the branch tip (three-way, from the candidate's own base) with a new `Git::merge_tree_report`. A clean merge goes to the existing resume path in a merge mode: the merged tree becomes the candidate on the new base, admission, checks, replay and the verifier run on it, no planner or producer runs, and the unchanged `land::plan` lands it, so the landed fingerprint is the verified one. A conflict starts an ordinary producer run whose work tree is seeded from git's conflicted merge, and the brief names the conflicted paths. The new `RunContext.conflicts` makes `check_and_verify` close the job before the checks and verifier when a conflict path still holds an opening and closing marker line. Marker-less conflicts (modify/delete, rename, binary) are not seen by that check; the brief, a git unit test, D159 and the CHANGELOG state the limit. A merge that equals the tip fails the job. If the candidate or base is gone, the base is no longer an ancestor, or the request is pinned, the retry starts from the base. Text changed: retry help, stale reader brief, `RetrySeed.conflicts` and a conflict brief section, a hint line when a job goes stale, the README, the CHANGELOG, and D159 appended (cites D10, reverses alternative (d), no supersession phrases). The decision-log guard in decisions.rs is re-pinned to the whole base (359622 bytes, measured before the append), checks the pin first, and requires an id one greater than the previous highest for entries past the pin; its pin errors end with "append at end of file". The full `cargo test --locked` run was killed by the background time limit before it finished. I ran the suites below instead; Athena's own run is the full check.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test shows `athena retry` on a stale job returns a proposal rather than an error.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test retry a_stale_job_can_be_retried` passes: it makes a job stale with a hand edit committed during verification, calls `Athena::retry`, gets Ok with a reading and no reader_error, and the old job stays stale. `cargo test -p athena-core a_stale_job_is_accepted_and_its_reason_is_carried` (reading.rs) also passes. Before the change `earlier_attempt_with` bailed for a stale job.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test where the kept candidate merges cleanly onto a moved branch tip shows checks, replay and verification run on the merged tree, the job lands, and no planner or producer call is recorded for the retry.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle a_stale_job_whose_candidate_merges_cleanly_lands_on_retry_with_no_producer_call` passes. The producer edits line 1 of a multi-line README and the branch appends a last line to the same file; the test shows no Planner/Producer/Critic role after the retry, one Verifier, the verifier snapshot holding both hunks, the `show` check's recorded output holding both hunks with `reused` false, the verification and replay records naming the merged candidate commit, the job Landed with both hunks, and the retry job's invocations only Reader and Verifier. For a README-only change the replay stage runs through the same `check_and_verify` call and records its candidate commit, but no crates/ change is involved.

open_issues: The full `cargo test --locked` did not finish in my run (killed by the 600 s background limit). The suites for every crate I changed passed, but athena-cli's drain and other test targets, and the doc tests, were not run by me.

`display::finished` in crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs is not a listed file and still ends a stale job's summary with 'ask again to redo the work'; the new close.rs line points to `athena retry <job>`. I left display.rs alone and said so in the CHANGELOG, as the plan's open question proposed.

Conflicts git reports without marker lines (modify/delete, rename, binary) are not detected mechanically. The producer brief asks for an explicit decision and the verifier judges the result; this limit is stated in the brief, a git unit test, D159 and the CHANGELOG.

The replay stage runs for the merged candidate through the shared `check_and_verify` call (the lifecycle test checks the replay record names the merged commit), but no test exercises a replay with a crates/ change on a stale retry.

I did not add the disjoint-file smoke variant that the plan mentioned as optional; the other lifecycle tests cover the merge, the conflict, leftover markers, the empty merge and a deleted conflict file.
mistakes: My first full `cargo test --locked` was started as a background command with the default 600 s limit and was killed before finishing; I should have given it the maximum timeout or run it in the foreground.

I edited run/mod.rs (moved the 'merge' UI line after the merge check and extended a doc comment) while that background run was compiling, so its binaries may not have matched the final source; I reran the athena-core lib tests and the stale lifecycle tests afterwards.
A first draft of the 'stale_seed is none' unit test borrowed `records` mutably and immutably at once and used a method that did not exist; both were fixed before the tests compiled.
learnings: `committed_text` in run/checks.rs is private to that module, and checks.rs is not a listed deliverable, so the marker guard in run/mod.rs reads the conflict paths with `git.show_file` directly (missing path reads as empty text).

`git merge-tree --write-tree -z --name-only --no-messages` prints the tree id, a NUL, then each conflicted path NUL-terminated; a modify/delete conflict is listed but its blob holds one side and no marker lines.

The parser in decisions.rs sees D144 followed by D146 because the D145 heading is not in the `## D<n> · ` shape, so an id rule applied from an old pin would fail on the real file; pinning the whole base file makes the rule apply only past it.

A job that goes stale has no resume mark (`settle_resume_marks` removes it on every close except an environment failure), so the retry reads the candidate from the job's `candidate` record and builds a synthetic mark.
Clippy's `large_enum_variant` fires on an enum that holds a `ResumeSeed` next to a small variant; `StaleSeed::Merge` is boxed.
The existing test `the_root_cause_is_named_in_the_changelog_and_the_log` requires the [Unreleased] CHANGELOG section to keep the D158 root-cause text, so new entries must be added inside it.
desires: A way to read the output of a background test run or a saved tool result inside the working directory, so a long run's pass or fail summary can be checked.
A foreground timeout above 20 minutes, or a producer-visible estimate of how long the full suite takes, to avoid losing a run to the limit.
